newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end up discounting strong govt.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end up discounting strong govt.

text.p: Greek equities advanced again on Wednesday, closing 0.80 percent up on buying interest in blue chips and other stocks with good valuations as more investors see a strong government emerging from the national elections.

"Buying interest, especially for blue chips and other stocks with good valuations, drove the benchmark index higher as more investors are convinced that a majority government will emerge from the elections," said Apostolos Constandinidis, fund manager at Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds.

Opinion polls have the ruling socialists and the opposition conservative running neck and neck for the early election on September 22, but Greece's voting law favours the winning party forming a single-party government.

The Athens general share index closed 0.80 percent, or 7.47 points higher at 938.60 from Tuesday's 931.13 close after opening at 930.97 points. Turnover rose to 9.21 billion drachmas on volume of 5.36 million shares.
